Hi Emma — quick technical answers and a proposed plan. Quoting your asks below for clarity.

> "Is audit log retention configurable to 7 years?"
Short answer: yes, but it requires a contract addendum for retention beyond default retention windows and affects storage/archival costs. We can surface logs to your S3 (encrypted) or maintain them in our archive with your retention policy applied. We'll include a retention schedule and estimated cost Delta in the contract addendum.

> "BYOK and CloudHSM integration?"
We support BYOK across our Private deployment: you can bring keys and integrate with CloudHSM or an external HSM via standard KMIP/PKCS11 interfaces. Key rotation on a 90-day cadence is supported; we also offer managed key escrow for disaster recovery only if requested. For Dedicated deployments (Redwood-managed control plane) we support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations but some HSM features (physical HSM appliances) are only available in Private.

> "VPC peering / static egress IPs?"
Private VPC: supports VPC peering, PrivateLink, or transit gateway; you control routing and firewalling on your side. We can provision static egress IPs for outbound traffic (useful for allowlisting with downstream vendors).
Dedicated: we can provide static egress IPs and restricted network paths, but you won’t have the same level of customer-managed networking control as Private. Hosted API: limited static IP guarantees and not recommended for PHI production.

Recommendation (based on PHI + long retention + BYOK):
- Pilot: spin up a small Private VPC pilot (isolated environment) so you can validate BYOK flows and log shipping.
- Production: full Private deployment with customer-managed control plane and CloudHSM integration.

Immediate deliverables from our side:

- Private VPC network playbook (attached) with step-by-step peering and route tables.
- Secure link to full SOC 2 Type II report: https://redwood.example.com/secure-reports/soc2/2026 (access requires the NDA we’ll provide).
